_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base-rate and analyst HOLD call dominate; downside cluster (inflows, CVD, flat funding) is watched but has not broken the range, so no directional claim.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicit HOLD/coil; narrative silent on direction but intake rise supports non-bullish stance, not a shared forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, composite holds mid-ladder, funding near flat, fear/greed still elevated
next_move.invalidated_if: CVD and funding flip positive with momentum >60 (up) OR fear/greed breaks <50 with spot accelerating lower and exchange netflow pinned (down)
